open_obligations: Note that finding more flaws and choosing correct solutions are different outcomes.
Check difficulty: hard contest code versus summaries humans evaluate in about ten minutes.
Check the size of McAleese et al.'s appendix experiment.
in.other_title: LLM critics did not help humans pick correct solutions to hard contest-code problems
in.rationale: Saunders et al. report critique assistance helps labelers find about 50% more critiques of summaries. McAleese et al. report broadly negative results when measuring human judge accuracy directly on hard competition-code problems: LLM critiques struggled to help contractors identify the correct solution within 20 minutes; the outcome measure (choosing the correct solution versus counting flaws found) and domain differ.
in.scope: proposed CHALLENGES: whether model-written critiques improve human evaluation outcomes

text: The paper reports that human labelers asked to find critiques of model- or human-written answers find about 50% more critiques when given assistance from a critique model, and that with deliberately misleading answers, assisted labelers find the intended critiques 50% more often.
title: Critique assistance: labelers find about 50% more critiques of summaries
